newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex says petrochemical plant quality certified.
newsitem.headline: Pemex says petrochemical plant quality certified.

text.p: The shipping centre of Mexico's fifth largest petrochemical complex has been given international quality certification, the state-owned oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said on Thursday.

"The ISO-9002 norm is obtained following a series of inspections and audits that guarantee industrial processes are being carried out in an orderly and systematic fashion," the company said in a statement.

The company's Pajaritos complex in Veracruz state was certified for the 41 petrochemical products produced by Pemex's petrochemical unit, Pemex said. The plant produced 1.22 million tonnes of petrochemicals in 1994.
Pemex is in the process of creating 10 companies from its petrochemical plants, in order to privatize a minority stake in the second half of the year.
